_about: Settings for the automatic per-submission job (assessment/auto/run-auto.js). autoSend=false means every result is prepared as an Outlook DRAFT only. Set autoSend=true only after the decision to share reports: then results with no Level 5-7 examples and no flags are marked to send, and everything else is held as a draft for review (Option B). The Windows task must also be started with -AllowSend before anything is sent. onlyEmails: when not empty, only submissions from these addresses are handled (for testing).
